_comment: Capability card for the local LM Studio (Bionic) models. quality is /10 on a graded probe; tok_s measured in isolation with nothing else resident. Update this file when the installed models change.

qwen/qwen3.5-4b.role: Volume workhorse: classify/extract/summarize batches, second opinions, long docs to ~55K tokens
qwen/qwen3.5-4b.notes: 3x faster than anything else here. The remember shim's primary. Thinks by default; server needs reasoning_effort:'none' for direct answers (this server handles that).

gemma-4-e4b-it-mlx.role: General default: best quality-per-second, syntax checks, refactors, test generation, multilingual, vision
gemma-4-e4b-it-mlx.notes: Best all-rounder measured (10/10). Vision score 4/6, fastest of the tied-top models, but nothing local reads worksheets reliably; route documents to ocr-doc first. Rejects reasoning_effort with HTTP 400 (this server only sends that field to qwen-arch models).

mistralai_ministral-3-14b-instruct-2512-.role: Max capability that fits: hard problems and reasoning the smaller models keep getting wrong
mistralai_ministral-3-14b-instruct-2512-.notes: 14B at MXFP4 (7.19GB). One of only two installed models to solve the multi-step reasoning probe. A third of e4b's speed; use when e4b is not enough.

qwythos-9b-claude-mythos-5-1m.role: Long context only: the sole local option past ~62K real tokens (~144K loaded)
qwythos-9b-claude-mythos-5-1m.notes: qwen3.5 arch GGUF. The 'Claude Mythos 5 distill' claim in its name is unverified third-party marketing; treat it as a good qwen fine-tune, nothing more.

supergemma4-e4b-abliterated-mlx.role: Uncensored variant; invoke explicitly, never auto-route
supergemma4-e4b-abliterated-mlx.notes: TEXT-ONLY: abliteration removed the vision tower, so the server 400s on image inputs. Invoke by exact id; never auto-route.

text-embedding-nomic-embed-text-v1.5.role: Embeddings only, not a chat model
text-embedding-nomic-embed-text-v1.5.notes: claude-find embeddings run elsewhere (llama-server + shim on :11434), not through this.

routing_notes: One chat model resident at a time on this 16GB machine; a load evicts the previous model. model:'auto' prefers the already-loaded model to avoid an 8-30s cold load.
Check Apple FM (Tier 0, apple-fm MCP) first for short classify/extract/summary tasks under ~3800 tokens: it is free with zero cold-load.
Keep on the hosted model (do NOT delegate here): anything needing session context, files, or memory, and multi-tool orchestration.
Delegation contract: prompts must be fully self-contained. The local model cannot see the Claude session, files, or memory; paste every input and constraint into the prompt.
LM Studio silently substitutes unknown model ids with whatever is loaded. This server refuses unknown ids client-side and verifies response.model on every call.
